title: Hand a produced file to a helper and get a derived file back

turns.prompt: In {D}: write sales.csv with columns region,amount and these 6 rows — north,120; south,80; north,45; east,200; south,15; east,5. Then hand that file to a helper (a subagent, not you) whose only job is to produce {D}/by_region.csv with one row per region and the summed amount, sorted by amount descending. Tell me the three totals when the helper is done.
turns.verify: f={D}/by_region.csv; test -f $f || { echo FAIL: no by_region.csv; exit 0; }; echo "SHOW $(tr '\n' '|' < $f)"; if grep -q '^east,205' $f && grep -q '^north,165' $f && grep -q '^south,95' $f && [ "$(grep -v -i '^region' $f | head -1 | cut -d, -f1)" = east ]; then echo PASS; else echo FAIL: totals or order wrong; fi

rubric.criteria: Pass if the reply gives the three totals (east 205, north 165, south 95) and says a helper produced by_region.csv; fail if the main agent clearly did the aggregation itself and only pretends, if totals are wrong, or if it asks the user for the data again.
